newsitem.title: USA: Bridgeport, Conn., pays high water rates - paper.
newsitem.headline: Bridgeport, Conn., pays high water rates - paper.

text.p: Residents of Bridgeport, Conn., and other towns served by a private water company pay some of the highest water rates in the state and more than most of the nation, the Connecticut Post says.
The paper called the water costs for towns served by B-H-C, a private company, the highest in the state.
In Bridgeport, water costs $91 per quarter for a family of four. But in Hartford, that same family pays $45 a quarter, and in New Haven, they pay $81 a quarter.
B-H-C's Kent subsidy is the most expensive at $171 per quarter for a family of four.
